item.description:
### Fixed - **A Claude session in a terminal is no longer badged APP.** If Perch hadn't yet matched the session to a running process, it assumed the session belonged to the Claude desktop app — even when the session itself recorded which terminal had started it. Two sessions of one project could sit side by side badged differently for no reason you could act on.
### Added - **Session rows now show which git branch they're on.** Two sessions in the same project used to look identical — a main checkout and a worktree both just read `perch`. The branch appears next to the project name, on the Mac and on your iPhone. Sessions outside a git repository are unchanged. A detached checkout shows the short commit instead.
